Select a Scanner

We publish two scanner configurations: the ERNIE toolkit (for education) and the main IMAGINE system (preclinical preclinical rat scanning).

Educational / Low-Cost

ERNIE Scanner

A mouse-sized 50 mT Halbach array scanner design meant for quick assembly on-site. Contains a 3-axis automated mapping robot to teach magnetic field homogeneity and shimming.

OSI² Score: 17 / 17
Explore ERNIE
Preclinical / Research

IMAGINE Preclinical Scanner

Our flagship 120mm bore preclinical scanner design. Documents full gradient and RF transmit/receive circuit systems, custom amplifier filters, and the MaRCoS console.

OSI² Score: 17 / 17
Explore IMAGINE

OSII Standard Compliance: General Report

This general report summarizes and compares open science standard compliance across our individual scanner projects, compiled dynamically from their OSII compliance files.

Design Considerations Explained Have the design considerations been explained? BoM Provided Is a Bill of Materials (BoM) provided to reproduce the design? Native Source Files Available Are all files needed to reproduce the project available in their native file format? Status of Freedom
Editable with Open-Source Software Are all source files editable with open-source software (e.g. FreeCAD, KiCAD)? Production Files
Accessible Exports Available Are all files needed to reproduce the project available in a generally accessible export file format (e.g. STP, STL, GRB)? Versioning Scheme Implemented Is a versioning scheme implemented (e.g. git repository)? Satisfied Git repository tracking in repository root [Link] Satisfied Managed under Git version control in repository tracking all commit revisions [Link]
Public Issue Tracking Is issue tracking implemented publicly? Satisfied GitHub Issues public tracker for bugs and suggestions [Link] Satisfied Issue tracker on GitHub repository for tracking bug reports and hardware revisions [Link]
Public Communication Space Does the project have a communication space for questions and developer exchange? Testing
Testing Routines Available Are testing routines available to evaluate the expected performance of the final design? Satisfied Comprehensive testing routines across all subsystems: Magnet (Hall compass and polarity checks), Robot gantry (3-axis stepper calibration), and Hall sensor probe (calibration against reference field) [Link] Satisfied Testing protocols available across all subsystems: Control (loopback in Hardware/Control_System/), Gradients (inductance/resistance in Hardware/Gradients/Gradient_Design.md), GPA (Hardware/Gradient_Power_Amplifier/README.md), RF (tuning in Hardware/RF_Coils/), and Magnet (field mapping in Hardware/Halbach Array/) [Link]
Testing Routines Complete Are testing routines complete (e.g. available for all subcomponents/subprocesses)? Use

Risk Assessment & Safety Notice Is a risk assessment or a safety notice available? Satisfied Safety surveys and magnet handling protocols in ERNIE/Training sessions/Training related surveys/Safety survey.pdf [Link] Satisfied Magnetic hazard warnings and non-magnetic assembly protocols in Hardware/Halbach Array/Part and build description.md [Link]
Replication History Documented Is information available if the project has been independently successfully replicated? IMAGINE Project

An open-source preclinical MRI initiative of the Consortium for Advancement of MRI Education and Research in Africa (CAMERA). Sustaining diagnostic health equity globally.

Open Science Compliance

All hardware files are released under open-source hardware licenses. This project is developed to satisfy the requirements of the Open Source Imaging Initiative (OSI²).
